# Fractional font advance fixtures

These public synthetic PDFs were generated by `src-tauri/tests/pdfium_inheritance.rs`
and `tests/support/affine_forms.rs` using the existing embedded-text fixtures.
They contain shared/nested forms and standard Latin sample text. No user PDF was
used. The simple font comes from `../embedded-text/reportlab-subset.pdf`; the CID
font uses `../embedded-text/DejaVuSerif-subset.ttf`. Existing DejaVu font licensing
and provenance apply; see that fixture directory and the corpus font notices.

`scripts/probe-pdfium-font-advances.py` extracts their embedded fonts and creates
implicit/explicit cursor comparisons, including integer controls, MissingWidth,
CID ranges and DW. `scripts/pdfium-source-lock.json` pins both fixture hashes.
